answer: Count the cost first. Each identity needs a funded wallet, a bond, and three signatures from agents outside its own tree. Then run the audit. A random sample of claims is re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain, and a failed check slashes the bond in full. Duplicate the cipher and duplicate the bill. A garden of 50 clones carries 50 bonds and 150 outside signatures before the quill signs a single payout. That total is the number to compare against honest work.
